# 7472 - J-K master-slave flip-flop

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7472.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7472.json)

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 8 | Q = state | Q is the stored bit. |
| 6 | /Q = NOT state | Q' is the inverse of the stored bit (both high while PR and CLR are both low). |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 1

Changes on: falling edge of CK (master-slave)

- J = J1 AND J2 AND J3; K = K1 AND K2 AND K3
- PR low, CLR high: Q = 1, Q' = 0 at once
- PR high, CLR low: Q = 0, Q' = 1 at once
- PR low, CLR low: Q = 1 and Q' = 1; not stable, does not persist when PR and CLR return high
- Master-slave, pulse triggered: J and K are taken in while CK is high (setup 0 ns before the rising edge, hold 0 ns after the falling edge); the outputs change on the falling edge of CK
- On a CK pulse with clear/preset inactive: J=0 K=0 hold; J=1 K=0 Q=1; J=0 K=1 Q=0; J=1 K=1 toggle

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PR | Q | PLH | 16 | 25 |
| PR | /Q | PHL | 25 | 40 |
| CLR | /Q | PLH | 16 | 25 |
| CLR | Q | PHL | 25 | 40 |
| CK | Q | PLH | 16 | 25 |
| CK | Q | PHL | 25 | 40 |
| CK | /Q | PLH | 16 | 25 |
| CK | /Q | PHL | 25 | 40 |

## Notes

The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delays; the path-delay function uses 0 ns for the minimum.
